notes.title: Version 1.6 - X-Mas-Special
notes.notes:
Version 1.6 is now available.

This version contains some x-mas specials and a smaller bugfix for the vr-mode.
Have fun, and creepy x-mas!

notes.title: Version 1.5 - Halloween Edition
notes.notes:
[b]Version 1.5 - Halloween Edition[/b]

With version 1.5 TheNighfall now also includes a halloween special edition.
From the time Oktober the 25th until November the 7th the game will activate the halloween mode.

Have fun!

notes.title: Version 1.4 - Virtual Reality support
notes.notes:
Version 1.4 of TheNightfall is now available.
Now the game supports virtual reality for HTC Vive in the game itself.
(The menus are still only working in 2D)
For further information please have a look at the community hub thread "Virtual Reality Support".

notes.title: Update to version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
We just updated the game to version 1.0.2.
With this version we fixed some smaller issues (no real bugs) and now a lot of gimmick items in the game appear a bit later to make it a bit easier to come into the main game, without spending too much time in the beginning with pure gimmicks.
